title: Student V0.1 — G5 corrective wave R1: App Experience + Activity Experience Lab + Pilot Activity Policy
purpose: Replace the superseded two-track corrective plan with three independent streams: shell-level App Experience repair, a bounded fail-fast Activity Experience Lab sub-product driven by frozen ActivityPresentation/ActivityResponse contracts, and a limited-pilot activity profile that excludes constructed free text without changing learnit.kit.v4 published meaning.

nextIndependentGate.purpose: consume accepted App Experience, human-selected Activity Lab specification, and independently reviewed Pilot Activity Policy; implement selected activity UX in production; fan-in and qualify G4 R1

streamA.name: APP_EXPERIENCE_R1
owns: progressive disclosure of detailed objective status

streamC.name: PILOT_ACTIVITY_POLICY_R1
streamC.contractMeaning: learnit.kit.v4 remains unchanged; this is a Student V0.1 limited-pilot admission profile

invariants: All three streams start from the exact same common base 18b925436777943b19c4b031c24659ad60dee133.
No stream may consume another stream result/evidence during authoring/prototyping.
G5 remains PENDING_HUMAN; no GO/HOLD decision is manufactured from engineering findings.
learnit.kit.v4 schema and published meaning remain unchanged.
Stream A does not modify activity_presenters.js or activity response semantics.
Stream B does not modify production apps/learnit-next/src/** in this job.
Stream B is an isolated prototype sub-product and must consume only learner-safe ActivityPresentation fixtures and emit only frozen ActivityResponse shapes.
Stream B cannot contain or derive scoring secrets and cannot evaluate correctness.

Stream B must provide at least two meaningfully different prototypes for flashcard, matching, order and classify; qcm/fill may serve as baseline references and lesson must have at least one simplified candidate.
Stream B must stop after producing a downloadable human prototype-review bundle; no prototype is integrated into production before explicit human selection.
Stream C does not alter the v4 schema or runtime support for constructed; it excludes constructed only from the limited Student V0.1 pilot profile.
Stream C removes the current constructed showcase activity rather than replacing it with invented content, unless independent source evidence proves a replacement is needed for objective coverage.
If the constructed activity is simply removed, course estimatedMinutes becomes 39 and objective coverage must remain complete.
Stream C also removes learner-facing internal provenance/program jargon identified by the G5 replay.
Stream C author-side result cannot claim independent semantic PASS; changed learner content requires later independent review.
A later ATLAS-WP-054 job, not this wave, owns production implementation of human-selected Activity Lab variants and corrective fan-in/G4 R1.

Stream B at least two prototype variants for flashcard, matching, order and classify, plus one simplified lesson and qcm/fill reference renderings.
Stream B response inspector showing exact ActivityResponse emitted by each interaction without correctness evaluation.
Stream B keyboard/mobile/accessibility browser checks on every candidate variant.
Stream B human micro-review bundle with one-page instructions and an explicit per-family/variant ACCEPT/REJECT decision form.
Stream B Phase A stops at HUMAN prototype selection; no product presenter mutation.

Stream C learner-visible internal jargon scan PASS.
Stream C objective coverage/source fidelity/canonical validation/pedagogical quality/revision-digest/source-traceability PASS.

Repository governance PASS on coordinator and every child branch.

adversarialTests: Do not solve activity UX by modifying production presenters before human prototype selection.
Do not build a generic plugin registry, dynamic loader, evaluator registry or event bus for the Activity Lab.
Do not let Activity Lab fixtures contain correctChoiceId, fill answers, acceptedResponses, matches, correctOrder or classify authored assignments.
Do not let the Activity Lab compute correctness or mastery.
Do not make drag-and-drop the only interaction path for matching/order/classify; keyboard/touch-safe fallback is mandatory.
Do not move app-shell progress/navigation concerns into the Activity Lab.
Do not treat constructed removal from the first pilot as deletion from learnit.kit.v4.
Do not add acceptedResponses variants as the primary fix for constructed in the pilot; constructed is excluded from the limited-pilot profile.
Do not invent replacement mathematical content merely to preserve 11 activities or 42 minutes.
Do not claim independent semantic review from the Stream C authoring session.
Do not infer a G5 human decision from the screenshots or engineering discussion.
Do not fan-in streams in this job.
independentReview: Stream A, Stream B and Stream C are authored from the same frozen base with no sibling consumption.
Stream B human selection is a separate fail-fast UX decision before any production implementation.
Stream C changed learner content is reviewed independently only in a later gate.
ATLAS-WP-054 independently integrates only accepted stream outputs and requalifies a new G4 candidate.
nonGoals: Production integration of Activity Lab prototypes.
rollback: Close the R1 coordinator and child DRAFT PRs and delete their branches. Historical G4/G5 Phase-A evidence remains unchanged.
